prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” AI video ad maker — the right one depends on your goals (social short-form vs. presenter-led vs. personalized at scale), budget, and how much creative control you want. Below are the top contenders by use case and what they’re best at.

Top picks (by use case)
- Synthesia — Best for AI presenters/avatars and multilingual voiceovers. Great when you want a human-like spokesperson without filming. Enterprise-oriented, easy script→video.
- HeyGen — Similar to Synthesia; strong for realistic avatars and localization.
- InVideo — Versatile, template-rich editor for social ads; good balance of features, ease, and price for marketers.
- Promo.com — Built for marketing ads: large stock library, ad-focused templates and aspect-ratio presets for Facebook/Instagram/TikTok.
- Pictory — Excellent for repurposing long-form content (webinars, blogs) into short social ads with captions and highlights.
- Descript — Best for text-based video editing, podcast-to-video repurposing, and voice cloning (Overdub). Good when script-driven editing is needed.
- Veed.io — Simple online editor with strong captioning/subtitle and brand-kit features for social ads.
- Runway — Advanced generative editing and creative effects for higher-end, eye-catching ads (backgrounds, inpainting, style transfer).
- Rephrase.ai / Loom-like personalization platforms — Best for personalized video ads at scale (dynamic names/messages).
- Biteable / Clipchamp / Adobe Express — Budget- or beginner-friendly template tools for fast production.

How to choose (quick checklist)
- Platform/format: Do you need vertical (TikTok/IG Reels) or widescreen (YouTube)? Pick a tool with templates for that format.
- Creative type: Want an on-screen AI spokesperson → Synthesia/HeyGen. Need repurposing → Pictory/Descript. Need flashy generative effects → Runway.
- Scale & personalization: Many ads per week or dynamic personalization → Rephrase.ai or tools with API/automation.
- Voice: Natural TTS and multilingual support are important for global ads.
- Brand control: Does it need brand kit, fonts, exact colors? Check for brand kit features.
- Budget: Some have free tiers for testing; advanced avatars, high-res exports, or enterprise features cost more.
- Integrations & analytics: Want direct ad-platform exports, A/B testing, or analytics? Confirm integrations.

My short recommendations
- Fast, social-first ad with templates: InVideo, Promo.com, or Veed.
- Presenter-style ad without shooting: Synthesia or HeyGen.
- Repurpose long content to short ads: Pictory or Descript.
- High-end creative/visual effects: Runway (+ a conventional editor).
- Personalized video campaigns: Rephrase.ai or a platform with dynamic fields and API.

If you tell me: platform (TikTok, Meta, YouTube), ad length, budget, whether you want an AI presenter or real footage, language(s), and monthly output, I’ll recommend the single best choice and a suggested workflow.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
